query: UPDATE baselines b JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id = b.user_id JOIN metric_types m ON m.id = b.metric_type_id SET b.status = 'FINAL', b.finalized_at = p.calibration_ends_at, b.effective_value = IF(m.direction = 'HIGHER_IS_BETTER', GREATEST(b.calibrated_value, COALESCE(b.declared_value, b.calibrated_value)), LEAST(b.calibrated_value, COALESCE(b.declared_value, b.calibrated_value))) WHERE b.status = 'PROVISIONAL' AND b.calibrated_value IS NOT NULL AND p.calibration_ends_at <= ?
